newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CANTERBURY KILL FREE STATE'S SEMI HOPES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CANTERBURY KILL FREE STATE'S SEMI HOPES.

text.p: Canterbury registered their first away victory in the Super 12 rugby series and killed Free State's chances of reaching the semifinals with a 16-11 victory on Saturday.
Canterbury moved into sixth place but cannot reach the final four after winning only four matches in their 10 outings.
Despite missing their experienced All Black half-back pairing of Andrew Mehrtens and Justin Marshall, full-back Daryl Lilley kept a steady head to guide the New Zealanders to victory.
Lilley scored all of side's points through a converted try and three penalties.
After sustained pressure by the home side on the Canterbury line, Free State scrum-half Werner Swanepoel opened the scoring in the 12th minute, diving over on the blindside from a five-metre scrum.
The score advanced to 8-3 as Lilley and Free State fly-half M.J. Smith traded penalties.
On the stroke of halftime, Canterbury snatched the lead when Lilley chased down a clever chip ahead by winger Afato So'oalo. Lilley converted to give his a 10-8 advantage.
Canterbury tightened their grip on the game after the break, stretching their lead to 16-8 courtesy of two Lilley penalties.
Smith closed the gap to five points with his second penalty two minutes from time.

Free State: Jorrie Kruger (Chris Badenhorst 74 min); Jan-Harm van Wyk, Helgard Muller (captain), Brendan Venter, Stephen Brink; M.J. Smith, Werner Swanepoel; Jaco Coetzee, Johan Erasmus, Andre Venter, Braam Els, Ryno Oppermann, Dougie Heymans (Willie eyer 42 min), Naka Drotske, Os du Randt.

Canterbury: Daryl Lilley; Afato So'oalo (Paula Bale 63 min), Tabai Matson, Mark Mayerhofler, Daryl Gibson; Leon MacDonald, Aaron Flynn; Clark Mcleod (Steve Surridge 69 min), Scott Robertson (Angus Gardiner 60 min), Todd Blackadder, Norman Maxwell, Mar Weedon, Con Barrell, Matt Sexton, Stuart Loe (Kevin Nepia 33 min).
